successors.name: Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan
successors.text: the West Bank, 'formally annexed on 24 April 1950'

ledger.x: May 1948: the Arab-held West Bank is left to the Palestinians when the Mandate ends.
May 1948: the Arab Legion holds the West Bank.
24 April 1950: the occupation ends in annexation.
24 April 1950: the West Bank joins Jordan.
24 April 1950: the Palestinian-held West Bank passes to Jordan.

wars.name: 1948 Arab-Israeli War
wars.outcome: Israel was established; the rest of Mandatory Palestine was 'occupied by Egypt or annexed by Jordan'; hundreds of thousands of Palestinians 'fled or were expelled' and Israel did not let them return.

certainty.note: The limits of the Arab-held land were the front lines of 1948 until the Jordan armistice of 3 April 1949 (the Green Line, sharp on the western side); the Jordan Valley side is the old Mandate frontier.

sources.title: Jordanian annexation of the West Bank
